meta.title: DSH-OpenRouter-Provider-Router
meta.description: Pin OpenRouter requests to the providers you choose. Open Settings → DSH-OpenRouter-Provider-Router, pick the model, add the providers, and save; every matching request then sends provider.only plus allow_fallbacks, so OpenRouter stops switching providers on its own. Applies only to requests this Harness sends to openrouter.ai; clearing the pin restores automatic routing.
